units.source_text: 尸体上半身穿的是浅蓝色的短上衣，头上戴着褶皱样式的京城乌帽，仰面躺在地上。

en.t: The corpse wore a pale blue short jacket on its upper body, had a pleated capital-style eboshi on its head, and lay face up on the ground.

units.source_text: 伤口在胸口上，看起来只有一刀，但似乎正中要害，鲜血染红了周围的竹叶。

en.t: The wound was on the chest and seemed to be only a single cut, but it appeared to have struck a vital spot, and fresh blood had stained the surrounding bamboo leaves red.

units.source_text: 没有，早不流血了，伤口早就干了。

en.t: No, the blood had already stopped flowing, and the wound had long since dried.
